scope: Expected assembly contact graph; positive buried engagements are intentional construction joints. No exception permits exposed duplicate/coplanar surfaces or moving-part penetration outside bearing axes and closure tongues/receiver clearance.

microwave_oven.Case with open front cavity: primary grounded chassis via four Anti-slip foot meshes; cavity is integral, inner faces assigned metal
microwave_oven.Flat ceramic cavity floor: seated into integral cavity floor by0.5mm
microwave_oven.Anti-slip foot*: top contacts case base atZ0.028; bottomZ0
microwave_oven.Recessed rear ventilation baffle: edges embedded beyond vent aperture width into case
microwave_oven.Door surround: Moving hinge leaf meshes; moving group
microwave_oven.Handle foot*: Door surround and Vertical door pull
microwave_oven.Fixed hinge leaf*: Case with open front cavity and Fixed hinge barrel
microwave_oven.Fixed hinge barrel*: Fixed hinge leaf and Door hinge axle
microwave_oven.Door hinge axle*: spans fixed and moving coaxial hinge barrels; embedded bearing surfaces intentionally intersect
microwave_oven.Moving hinge barrel*: Door hinge axle and Moving hinge leaf; moving group
microwave_oven.Moving hinge leaf*: Moving hinge barrel and Door surround; moving group
microwave_oven.Door closure tongue*: Door surround; enters actual case receiver recess on closing, no active latch simulation
microwave_oven.Power cable: Cord strain relief to Unplugged power plug; lowest tube surface must be at or above ground

rice_cooker.Hollow cooker housing: primary body supported by four Rubber support foot meshes
rice_cooker.Rubber support foot*: top embedded into lower housing, bottomZ0
rice_cooker.Pot heater support seat: housing bottom, liner bottom and removable pot bottom; intentionally buried positive contacts; no heating simulation
rice_cooker.Dark inner cavity liner: Pot heater support seat and housing
rice_cooker.Removable inner cooking pot: Pot heater support seat at bottom; rim contacts closed Lid sealing gasket
rice_cooker.Rear hinge fixed bracket*: Hollow cooker housing and Rear hinge bracket neck; lowered below moving lid
rice_cooker.Fixed hinge barrel*: Rear hinge bracket neck and Lid hinge axle
rice_cooker.Lid hinge axle: spans both fixed barrels and moving center barrel; buried bearing engagement intentional
rice_cooker.Moving center hinge: Lid hinge axle and Lid hinge bridge; moving group
rice_cooker.Lid hinge bridge: Moving center hinge and Lid shell; moving group
rice_cooker.Inner lid plate: embedded underside of Lid shell; separate editable mesh, moving group
rice_cooker.Lid sealing gasket: Lid shell and closed inner pot rim; moving group
rice_cooker.Steam vent lining: 0.2mm positive radial embedding in actual lid/innerplate bore; full connected through-path; moving group
rice_cooker.Release button: Lid shell; visual control only, moving group
rice_cooker.Power cable: Rear cord relief to Unplugged power plug; tube clear of ground
rice_cooker.Rear hinge bracket neck*: Lowered rear fixed bracket to fixed barrel, positioned behind moving lid sweep
